covered_report_window: Thursday, August 13, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Friday, August 14, 2026 before the U.S. market open
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were advancing toward records after July PPI was flat month over month and eased to 4.7% year over year, supporting technology shares, while Friday's retail-sales and consumer-sentiment releases create an additional macro gap risk before the next open.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 13 after close; 4:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: FFRCT volume, Plaque adoption, and 2026 revenue guidance
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: No second raise; operating loss stays sticky
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Durable FFRCT volume, faster Plaque adoption, 80%+ gross margin, and a prior guide raise create the cleanest upside setup if management can at least defend the raised 2026 outlook.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The market expects continued roughly 30% revenue growth and maintenance of the raised $228 million to $232 million 2026 revenue range.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Revenue growth stays near 40%, Plaque adoption remains ahead of plan, and guidance rises or the profitability path improves.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Growth normalizes abruptly, sales and R&D spending keep losses elevated, or management only reiterates after the stock's recent recovery.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current public implied-move quote was available; recent price recovery raises the beat-and-raise bar modestly.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage is broadly constructive; recent published targets clustered around $35 to $40.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 13 after close; 5:00 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Take-rate mix, working capital, and FCF quality
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Six quarters of 50%+ TPV growth and record gross profit support upside if volume converts into better operating leverage rather than another take-rate or cash-flow disappointment.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Published consensus is near $0.18 to $0.19 EPS, but the more important bar is continued TPV growth with gross-profit and operating-profit conversion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: TPV remains above 50% growth, gross profit tracks volume better, and second-half operating leverage becomes visible.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Lower-rate local-to-local mix, narrower FX spreads, or working-capital drag make headline volume growth look low quality.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public event-volatility data were incomplete; the stock is below its 12-month high, reducing but not removing expectation risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Truist raised its target to $17 in July and published consensus remains constructive.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Risk-adjusted NIM, cost of risk, and loan growth
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Two consensus misses; FX and Peru macro sensitivity
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record first-quarter income, 5.8% risk-adjusted NIM, and improving Peruvian loan demand favor upside if credit costs stay below the full-year range.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The market expects sequential earnings growth; published USD-translated consensus is about $7.20 EPS and $1.72 billion revenue, though currency conversions vary by provider.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NIM stays near the top of guidance, cost of risk remains contained, and loan growth runs near or above 8.5%.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Credit normalizes faster than expected, efficiency weakens, or another headline consensus miss dominates solid underlying ratios.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options liquidity is thinner than U.S. mega-caps; the setup is driven more by bank KPIs and currency/macro than a clean implied-move signal.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Citi lifted its target to $440 in July, while Goldman raised its target to $374 but stayed Neutral.

ranked_companies.timing: Aug. 13 after close; 4:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Fiscal Q4 Semiconductor Systems revenue and gross-margin guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: 52x trailing P/E and a beat already priced in
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI-driven DRAM, leading-edge logic, and advanced packaging support another strong quarter, but the valuation and run-up mean the stock needs an unmistakable fiscal-Q4 guide, not merely a beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $9.01 billion revenue and $3.39 EPS versus management's prior $8.95 billion and $3.36 midpoints.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Semiconductor Systems exceeds the roughly $6.9 billion prior guide and fiscal Q4 revenue growth is clearly above current expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Gross margin, China/export commentary, or fiscal Q4 growth falls short of the elevated buy-side bar despite a clean Q3 beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: A recent public snapshot implied about a 13.9% move; the stock's roughly $444 billion market cap and 52x trailing P/E show a demanding setup.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Stifel reiterated Buy and a $650 target, expecting 13%+ sequential revenue growth and viewing fiscal-Q4 estimates as conservative.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: NOAA permit timeline and offshore procurement
